activity_scope: structural exclusions only, not effective degrees of freedom or empirical nonzero-gradient count

initial_model_configuration.anchor_grid: equal physical cell midpoints with cell-width masses
initial_model_configuration.source_encoder: same independent plain-boundary GNN and observed selected features
initial_model_configuration.memory_interface: queries only; references clamped independently encoded observed sources
initial_model_configuration.scale_mixture: softmax over scales, global per layer/channel, separate branch states
initial_model_configuration.normalization: matching ones query/reference source scans; no floor
initial_model_configuration.source_maps: bounded tanh q/r, shared across scales in each layer
initial_model_configuration.self_term: inclusive forward plus exclusive reverse counts once
initial_model_configuration.decoder: each layer exact readout-coordinate action from its fixed anchor sources and same gate
initial_model_configuration.limitations: finite anchor action, no continuous nonlinear integral or anchor-refinement guarantee; no performance/novelty result
